title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
inputFormat: Implement zigzagLevelOrder(root). The runner converts the level-order input array into nodes with val, left, and right fields; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: An array of levels, alternating left-to-right and right-to-left order, starting left-to-right at the root. Return [] for an empty tree.

visuals.title: Alternate the reading direction

visuals.caption: Visit levels from top to bottom. Reverse the reading order on every second level.
